## Positioning

DesertScape Co plans, coordinates, supplies, constructs, and maintains landscape works for refined outdoor environments in Saudi Arabia. The company focuses on hospitality assets, residential compounds, private clients, public realm, commercial developments, governmental environments, infrastructure corridors, parks, sports, entertainment, and mega-project related outdoor works.

## Services

Survey and site assessment:
Site review, measurements, access study, constraints mapping, utilities awareness, soil observations, existing asset inventory, and early delivery notes.

Landscape design:
Concept, schematic, detailed, and construction stage landscape design for refined outdoor environments in Saudi Arabia.

Supply and procurement:
Procurement support for plants, palms, trees, hardscape, irrigation, lighting, furniture, play, sports, and specialist landscape components.

Landscape construction:
Construction execution for softscape, hardscape, irrigation, lighting, water features, civil works, infrastructure, and public realm assets.

Operation and maintenance:
Preventive and corrective maintenance plans that protect landscape value through routine care, reporting, and performance management.

## Landscape elements

Softscape:
Trees, palms, shrubs, groundcovers, seasonal flowers, turf, soil improvement, mulch, gravel, and planting works.

Hardscape:
Paving, stone, concrete, asphalt, walls, curbs, plazas, walkways, outdoor finishes, and public realm surfaces.

Irrigation:
Drip systems, sprinkler systems, controllers, pumps, tanks, filtration, drainage coordination, efficiency review, and maintenance.

Water features:
Fountains, water mirrors, cascades, ponds, pump rooms, filtration interfaces, testing, and commissioning.

Civil, MEP, and infrastructure:
Landscape-related civil works, external infrastructure, electrical interfaces, mechanical interfaces, and coordination packages.

Lighting and sound systems:
Feature lighting, safety lighting, control systems, outdoor audio, event-ready sound points, and coordinated electrical interfaces.

Landscape automation and IoT:
Smart irrigation controllers, sensors, weather stations, pump and valve automation, lighting controls, monitoring, alerts, and BMS or IoT integration.

Outdoor furniture:
Benches, bins, bollards, planters, tables, loose furniture, fixed seating, wayfinding, and public realm accessories.

Landscape structures:
Shade structures, pergolas, gazebos, trellises, kiosks, screens, and custom outdoor landscape features.

Playgrounds, parks, and open spaces:
Playgrounds, fitness areas, parks, trails, sports fields, plazas, and family outdoor destinations.

Nursery and tree services:
Nursery planning, tree supply, tree production, tree removal, tree relocation, palms, indoor plants, and planters.

Commercial and mixed use:

## Common buyer questions

### What kind of company is DesertScape?

DesertScape Co is a Riyadh-based landscape company and landscape contractor serving Saudi Arabia. The legal company name is Desert Landscape Company.

Evidence:
https://www.desertscapeco.com/data/company.json

### Which project stages can DesertScape support?

Published service coverage includes survey and site assessment, landscape design, supply and procurement, landscape construction, and operation and maintenance. Focused pages also cover irrigation systems, softscape, hardscape, hospitality, residential compounds, public realm, and landscape automation and IoT.

Evidence:
https://www.desertscapeco.com/data/services.json

### Where does DesertScape operate?

DesertScape is based in Riyadh and serves projects in Saudi Arabia. International consultants, contractors, developers, and procurement teams may use the public resources to evaluate DesertScape as a Saudi landscape partner; this does not mean DesertScape performs projects outside Saudi Arabia.

Evidence:
https://www.desertscapeco.com/data/service-areas.json

### Does DesertScape provide maintenance?

Yes. The published scope includes preventive and corrective landscape operation and maintenance, routine care, reporting, and performance management.

Evidence:
https://www.desertscapeco.com/services/operations-maintenance
https://www.desertscapeco.com/services/landscape-maintenance-riyadh

### Does DesertScape support landscape automation and IoT?

Yes. The published scope includes smart irrigation controllers, sensors, weather stations, pump and valve automation, lighting controls, monitoring, alerts, and BMS or IoT coordination.

Evidence:
https://www.desertscapeco.com/services/landscape-automation-iot-riyadh
